facts.rubric: Applied the effective order and policy to establish 7 CHAIR_HOUR for chair-hours for one continuous first-dose rituximab infusion (360 min infusion + 60 min observation), with control date 2026-03-13.
facts.statement: The effective order and policy establish chair-hours for one continuous first-dose rituximab infusion (360 min infusion + 60 min observation) = 7 CHAIR_HOUR: the first-dose protocol makes the 360 + 60 minute infusion one continuous 7-chair-hour block on a first-dose-capable chair. The control date is 2026-03-13 (Dr. Mbeki: day 1 no later than Friday 2026-03-13 because the steroid taper starts 2026-03-16).

facts.rubric: Reconciled 16 observed less 12 excluded to 4 supported CHAIR_HOUR for chair-hours on first-dose-capable chairs (CHAIR-1, CHAIR-2) on the requested Thursday 2026-03-12.
facts.statement: on 2026-03-12 the two capable chairs offer 16 chair-hours in gross; CHAIR-1 is protected all day (8 h) and CHAIR-2 AM is booked (4 h), leaving 4 usable hours, 3 short of the 7 required; eligibility requires netting the exclusions rather than trusting a header total.

facts.rubric: Used the independently confirmed 2026-03-18 expedited readiness input for split_infusion_across_two_sessions, then separately derived its 2026-03-12 operating outcome under continuous monitoring on a first-dose-capable chair without displacing protected sessions instead of treating a supplier promise as authorization or a completion date.
facts.statement: Cascadia's confirmed day-15 restock dates on Q-77901: Cascadia Q-77901 confirms the day-15 restock standard 2026-03-20 and expedited 2026-03-17 (+USD 190); day 1 itself is covered by 3 dispensable 4410 vials; a supplier confirmation alone proves neither eligibility nor approval.

facts.rubric: Applied free full-day chair sessions with first-dose nursing cover to derive the three option outcomes without using protected or blocked sessions.
facts.statement: free full-day chair sessions with first-dose nursing cover: the first free full day on a capable chair is CHAIR-2 on 2026-03-13 (AM and PM both free); CHAIR-3 is free Thursday but has no certified cover; protected and blocked sessions cannot be displaced.

facts.rubric: Applied AP-CO-0103 only to book_first_nondisplacing_full_day and APPT-24507; kept extend_thursday_with_overtime_nursing outside current authority.
facts.statement: AP-CO-0103 authorizes regular sessions on CHAIR-1 or CHAIR-2 with zero overtime hours; overtime needs the nursing director separately and oncology blocks need the medical director. The approval does not select an option in advance and does not authorize extend_thursday_with_overtime_nursing.

facts.rubric: Compared all three alternatives and selected book_first_nondisplacing_full_day: it is the best currently authorized response that satisfies continuous monitoring on a first-dose-capable chair without displacing protected sessions.
facts.statement: rheumatology needs day 1 no later than 2026-03-13 so the taper can start on schedule; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside continuous monitoring on a first-dose-capable chair without displacing protected sessions.

options.consequence: book first non-displacing full day uses CHAIR-2's free AM and PM sessions on 2026-03-13, keeps continuous first-dose monitoring on a certified chair, lands on the control date, and costs nothing extra.
options.label: book_first_nondisplacing_full_day: outcome 2026-03-13, incremental cost USD 0, SUPPORTED_AND_APPROVED

options.consequence: split infusion across two sessions would use Thursday's single free CHAIR-2 PM session plus a second day, but the first-dose protocol requires one continuous monitored infusion, so the evidence does not support it.
options.label: split_infusion_across_two_sessions: outcome 2026-03-12, incremental cost USD 0, FAILS_CURRENT_CONTROL

options.consequence: extend Thursday with overtime nursing would run CHAIR-2 from 12:30 to 19:30 on 2026-03-12, one day earlier, and adds USD 520, but overtime nursing hours need the nursing director's separate approval, which AP-CO-0103 explicitly withholds.
options.label: extend_thursday_with_overtime_nursing: outcome 2026-03-12, incremental cost USD 520, SEPARATE_APPROVAL_OR_POLICY_EXCEPTION_REQUIRED

interaction_contract.investigation_evidence: Retrieve the applicable source records, policy, approval, and evidence through the connected provider tools before the first state change. The tool CLI, MCP, REST, and web tool forms share one audited trace. Reading /workspace/evidence directly is a convenience, but filesystem reads are not recorded and do not satisfy required tool investigations.
interaction_contract.stakeholder_draft: Leave an unsent draft for the requested recipient. Its body must name the persisted primary record and supported outcome date; research drafts must also identify the current definition. Preserve the business reference and explain the decision and constraints. An internal option identifier is required only in the structured answer, not in prose.
interaction_contract.text_matching: Required text facts use case-insensitive, punctuation-normalized whole tokens. Dates use ISO YYYY-MM-DD. These are structural checks, not a semantic assessment of arbitrary prose or contradictions.
